name: alberta_catalogue_search
description: Search the Alberta provincial open-data catalogue by keyword. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Alberta dataset about X". Each hit carries its publisher (organization), licence, update frequency, file formats, number of resources. Use alberta_catalogue_dataset for one dataset in full. Source: Government of Alberta, Open Alberta.

organization.description: Optional publisher (organization) name slug to restrict to, as shown in results.

name: alberta_catalogue_dataset
description: One Alberta open dataset in full, by its name slug or id (from alberta_catalogue_search): title, description, publisher, licence (id, title, link), update frequency, dates, tags, every resource (format, size, download link); the portal does not serve datastore field types, so open the resource download link for its columns. Source: Government of Alberta, Open Alberta.

id.description: Dataset name slug or id, e.g. the "name" returned by alberta_catalogue_search.
